fact_text: The analyst argues that most of a geopolitical shock is priced in on the first trading day, so investors who sell on that day and wait for de-escalation usually re-enter at a higher price.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'War Time Investing - My Thoughts on PSX - 5 March 2026' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Investors who bought shares with borrowed money can be forced to sell into a sharp fall when margin calls arrive, which removes their option to wait for recovery and can deepen the decline.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'War Time Investing - My Thoughts on PSX - 5 March 2026' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In March 2026 the analyst assigned about 70% to a quick de-escalation, which he expected to produce a V-shaped recovery, and 30% to a prolonged conflict, which he expected to bring sideways trading and a slower recovery.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'War Time Investing - My Thoughts on PSX - 5 March 2026' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A short oil-price spike is not enough to break Pakistan's equity bull framework; the analyst sees that risk only if high oil prices persist for roughly two to three years.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'War Time Investing - My Thoughts on PSX - 5 March 2026' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: If the government absorbs higher oil prices through subsidies or fails to collect petroleum taxes, the IMF programme can be derailed and pressure builds on the currency.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'War Time Investing - My Thoughts on PSX - 5 March 2026' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects the government to eventually pass higher oil prices through to consumers, which would give oil-linked producers a windfall gain.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'War Time Investing - My Thoughts on PSX - 5 March 2026' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues that markets price in expected outcomes based on past behaviour, so extreme commodity spike forecasts often do not materialise because forward prices already reflect them.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'War Time Investing - My Thoughts on PSX - 5 March 2026' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In the prolonged-disruption scenario the analyst set out in March 2026, oil-related companies with improving results could see higher earnings, making them candidates for the analyst's watchlist.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'War Time Investing - My Thoughts on PSX - 5 March 2026' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: During an uncertain period, the analyst's personal style is to deploy about half of planned capital gradually on price dips and hold the other half until a major de-escalation.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'War Time Investing - My Thoughts on PSX - 5 March 2026' (YouTube transcript, undated)
